_why_aim_553: Chapter 'A Default 1 Simple Smoke For Lineups' passed its gate on the second localize run with an AIM of 561.54-561.70 (0.16s), under merge_spans' 0.25s clip floor. The localizer was right that the clean aim is short: Tseeky's editor punch-in on the left/right-click HUD scales the frame until ~561.53, and the jump-throw begins at ~561.70. Measured frame-exact (frames.sh, y_v26aim.png at 561.30-561.75): 561.30-561.45 is fully zoomed (no minimap, oversized ability bar); 561.50 is the last easing frame, the minimap back and the scene already at the settled aim view; 561.533-561.70 is identical and unzoomed; by 561.75 the hand is dropping into the windup. The AIM is opened to 561.47 so the clip meets the floor, which admits ~3 frames of the zoom's final easing onto the SAME aim, never a different view. stand/throw/landing are unchanged.

553.provenance: AIM widened 561.54-561.70 -> 561.47-561.72 by operator frame-study (frames.sh y_v26aim.png, frame-exact): settled unzoomed aim 561.533-561.70, the last editor zoom-out easing frames 561.47-561.53 onto that same view, hand still until 561.70 and dropping by 561.75. stand/throw/landing are gate-passed localizer values.
